prose.text: Shift leads need a daily report of short picks per picker to target retraining and reduce errors.
Sam spends about four hours every Monday building the report in Excel from a WMS export; the WMS dashboard only shows building totals.
Automate a daily per-picker short-pick report, ready by 6am, using WMS pick confirmations, with cancelled lines excluded and wrong-location scans counted.
Over picks and anything not in WMS pick confirmations are out of scope.
If the new report disagrees with WMS two weeks in a row, Sam will switch back to his spreadsheet.

acceptance.given: WMS pick confirmation data is available and processed as described
acceptance.when: the report is generated by 6am for each picker, per shift, per day, with short picks counted as confirmed quantity less than task quantity, cancelled lines excluded, and wrong-location scans included
acceptance.then: the shift leads can use the report to target retraining

acceptance.given: the report numbers disagree with WMS pick confirmations two weeks in a row
acceptance.then: he switches off the new report and returns to his spreadsheet

guardrails.text: If the report disagrees with WMS pick confirmations two weeks in a row, switch it off.
Return to manual Excel report if the automated report is not trusted.
